notes.title: Thunder Wolves Update Released
notes.notes:
An update to Thunder Wolves has been released:

-	Added reconfigurable controls option
-	Added invertable aim option
-	Fixed resolution issues when using multiple monitors

notes.title: Thunder Wolves update - 19 June, 2013
notes.notes:
Hi Guys,

A bit later than we hoped (the submission process on certain platforms you do not mention on a PC forum took more time than we anticipated :) but the update with a few important additions/fixes you suggested is finally available.

Thank you all for your support of 'Thunder Wolves' and we hope the update opens the door for new fans as well.

Update notes

-          Added reconfigurable controls option

-          Added invertable aim option

-          Fixed resolution issues when using multiple monitors
